body:
Slice 1 of 5 of #637, split before its first Do run per the 2026-07-31 re-slicing (each slice budgeted at ~1,500 added semantic lines or less). Depends only on #634 (merged, PR #645). Schedule after #638's accepted patch is published and merged — it touches the same custodian test files.

Note: #637's plan declares a load-bearing conflict with #625 (#625 widens `reconcile_step`'s signature; 637 builds first, 625 builds on it) — all five 637 slices precede #625.

## What

`orphan_leases` and the mark sweep walk the `orphan:` ledger with `scan_page`, never a single `scan` (one maximum segmented-object retirement installs ~1.78 M marks against `SCAN_CAP = 1 << 20`, and `scan` fails whole, aborting the entire reconcile step) — under a bounded per-pass page budget, the design call this issue owns: #508's 7th attempt replaced the capped `scan` with an unbounded `loop { scan_page }` that materialised every entry into one HashMap, trading a loud failure for a multi-hundred-MB custodian allocation. A bounded per-pass budget changes what one GC pass may conclude, so the conclusion rules under a partial walk are part of this slice, not an implementation detail.

## Acceptance

- a population past `SCAN_CAP` is processed across passes without materialising it whole (peak memory asserted); what a pass may conclude from a partial walk is explicit and tested;
- `cargo xtask ci` green.

Part of #637 / #508 / epic #513.

milestone.description: First tagged release (Alpha). Scheduled after the two production-metadata milestones complete: #14 (Metadata Store FoundationDB) and #5 (M4 — Production metadata backend) — i.e. after the FDB go/no-go (#442) records go, the default flips to FDB, and TiKV development stands down (#443). No due date yet; it follows those two. Starts empty as the release marker.

title: custodian: GC ledger walk via scan_page with a bounded per-pass budget (637.1)
